title: Eval activation workflow for model pins and config updates
creator: Ethan Brooks
description: Add an automated eval activation workflow that runs a targeted suite of quality, latency, and safety checks anytime a model version is pinned or a runtime-serving configuration is changed. This applies to both platform catalog model upgrades (catalog-origin pins) and customer-driven pins/config updates. The goal is to catch regressions early, provide a clear pass/fail signal (and diagnostic artifacts), and integrate with rollout and rollback policies in Console.
background: We currently run evals manually and have several ad-hoc preflight checks. Recent incidents (see incident link) show regressions slipping through when teams pin a new model or change quantization/batching settings. PM and Console owners requested a deterministic activation point: immediately after a pin or a top-level config change. This ticket scopes the engineering changes required to reliably trigger, run, compare, and report eval results as part of the pin/upgrade flow.
proposal: 1) Define trigger surface: pin event, model-version-upgrade, and config-diff events (quantization, precision, batching profile, KV cache policy, prompt-template overrides). 2) Create an Eval Orchestrator job that runs a two-tier suite: a lightweight smoke suite (latency SLO, token-cost delta, top-level quality checks) and a full regression suite for tasks where the model is commonly used. 3) Compare results vs baseline (previous pinned version for that customer/catalog entry) and absolute thresholds. 4) If regression exceeds configured sensitivity, mark pin as `evaluation-failed` and run the configured fallback: auto-pause rollout, notify owners, open an ENG ticket, and optionally auto-rollback (opt-in via rollout policy). 5) Surface results in Console with a one-click rerun and links to diagnostic artifacts. 6) Default runs use synthetic, curated prompt sets to avoid customer data leakage; customers can optionally enable private evals using their in-house prompt sets (on Dedicated/Private deployments only).
acceptance_criteria: Trigger fires on catalog pin and customer pin events in the control plane
Smoke suite completes within 5 minutes for the majority of catalog models
Regression detection compares against prior pinned baseline and flags regressions according to thresholds
Console shows an Eval status card in the model pin/upgrade flow with link to results and a rerun button
Playbooks exist for automated pause/rollback and for a manual override path
End-to-end tests in CI that simulate a pin event and assert orchestration and state transitions
implementation_notes: Event plumbing: extend model-service to emit `pin.created` and `config.diffed` events with immutable metadata snapshot
Eval runner: reuse existing evals-runner but add `activation_context` (catalog vs customer) and synthetic prompt-set tagging
Comparison logic: implement delta metrics (relative quality drop, absolute thresholds, latency percentiles) and a configurable sensitivity setting per project/customer
Console UX: add `Run preflight evals` checkbox in the pin modal and an Eval status widget on model detail pages
Security/privacy: default to non-customer data; for private evals require KMS keys and customer opt-in documented
Cost control: limit full regression runs to canary capacity and sample size; add quota meter for eval compute consumption
comments: 2026-03-10 - Ethan Brooks: scoped initial spike; spike found that a smoke eval (100 prompts) can run <3m on typical catalog models with batching enabled, cost estimate ~0.2 GPU-hours per run.
2026-03-11 - Priya Nair: design review with PM — PM wants explicit opt-out for enterprise customers that have internal rollout policies; agreed to add an opt-in toggle for private prompt sets.
2026-03-12 - Infra/Spike: discovered that KV-cache resets during evaluation cause artificial latency variance; decided to warm caches before smoke suite and record cold vs warm metrics separately.
2026-03-13 - UX feedback (Ana Gomez): add clear visual state for `evaluation-pending`, `evaluation-passed`, `evaluation-failed` and a short summary line highlighting top 3 regressions.

2026-03-14 - PR opened: github.com/redwood-inference/platform/pull/4281 implements the event schema and the initial trigger handler (needs evaluator integration). Next: connect evals-runner and wire Console widgets. Assigned follow-up ENG tasks for rollout policy integration.
